nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-investing in early army units that could delay your tech or economy. Also avoid being caught off guard by early pressure; keep a defensive structure or unit ready.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing your technology and economy while maintaining a light defense. Increase production and consider expanding to support your tech-heavy build.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or if you scout an aggressive move. Also re-check if your economy or tech is falling behind.
nodes.next_state_summary: Progress to a state where you have a ground-oriented army with Stalkers and Observers, and your economy and tech are both heavy.

nodes.title: Early Game Tech and Economy Focus
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a more defined ground-based army with Stalkers and Observers, while maintaining heavy tech and economy. Aim to secure a second expansion.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid neglecting defense; the opponent may attempt a timing attack. Also avoid over-expanding without sufficient army to defend.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army and increasing production. Maintain your economy and tech lead. Consider adding Sentries or Immortals based on scouting.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate if you scout a tech switch (e.g., Banshees or Cloaked units) or if the opponent becomes aggressive. Also re-check your supply and resource balance.
nodes.next_state_summary: Progress to a state with a more advanced ground army, possibly including Immortals, and a heavy defense posture.

nodes.own_situation: You have a solid ground army with Zealots, Stalkers, and Observers. Your economy and tech are heavy, and you have expanded. Production is heavy, allowing for continuous unit reinforcement.
nodes.strategic_reason: With a strong economy and tech, you can out-produce the opponent. Observers provide vision to avoid surprises. This is a safe development phase to build a decisive advantage.
nodes.title: Mid-Early Game Ground Army Development
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a mid-game army with Siege Tank counters like Immortals or Colossus, while maintaining heavy economy and tech.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid engaging unsieged Siege Tanks without proper positioning. Also avoid neglecting upgrades or falling behind in tech.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army, focusing on units that counter Siege Tanks, such as Immortals or Colossus. Maintain your economy and tech lead, and consider adding air support if needed.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate if the opponent switches to air (e.g., Battlecruisers) or if they attempt a multi-pronged attack. Also re-check your army composition for balance.
nodes.next_state_summary: Progress to a state with a more advanced army composition, possibly including Colossus or High Templar, and a heavy defense posture.

nodes.strategic_reason: Siege Tanks are a core threat; Immortals and Colossus are effective. Your heavy economy allows for a larger army and tech upgrades. Observers provide crucial vision.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Army Consolidation
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into a late-midgame army with Colossus or High Templar, and possibly a fleet of Void Rays or Carriers if the opponent goes heavy on air.
nodes.trigger_summary: Around 420-540 seconds, own posture is ground-oriented with heavy production, tech, economy, and expansion. Opponent is ground-oriented with Siege Tanks, Marines, and Medivacs, heavy production and tech.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to defense at the expense of your tech or economy. Also avoid expanding too early without army support.
nodes.decision_direction: Increase production and consider a defensive structure or unit to hold off early pressure. Continue tech and economy development, and prepare to expand.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate if the opponent's aggression is confirmed or if you successfully defend. Also re-check your economy to ensure you can support further tech.
nodes.next_state_summary: Progress to a state with a ground-oriented army and a secured expansion.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order.
opening.opening_summary: A Protoss opening that emphasizes heavy technology and economy investment while maintaining moderate production. The early game is characterized by a Zealot-based ground presence and a focus on tech structures, with the intention of transitioning into a robust mid-game army. The opening is flexible, allowing for adaptation to Terran pressure or greedy play.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a technology / economy / production posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
